title: Fox’s Confession That He Made “Calderón Win” Is Serious and Proves Us Right, Sheinbaum Says
author: Lilian Hernández and Arturo Sánchez
content:
_This article by[Lilian Hernández and Arturo
Sánchez](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Lilian%20Hern%C3%A1ndez%20y%20Arturo%20S%C3%A1nchez)
originally appeared in the [November 3, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/03/politica/sheinbaum-
califica-como-grave-intromision-de-fox-en-elecciones-de-2006-a-favor-de-
felipe-calderon), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. The statements by former president Vicente Fox to a Spanish
digital newspaper, in which he admits that **he took part in the fraud of the
2006 elections** , “prove us right,” which is very serious, said the president
of Mexico, Claudia Sheinbaum.

During today’s morning press conference, she was asked for her opinion on
these statements Fox made to that outlet, and after listening to the audio,
which was played on a cell phone, the president said that what the former PAN
president revealed is “terrible.”

“He says that he took part in the 2006 election and that governing Mexico is
like governing a company, as if it were a business; for them it was a
business, for Marta Sahagún and her sons and for him.”

In that interview, the former president stated that he sought to keep the
presidency of the Republic in the hands of the PAN and that is why “Calderón
wins, or you can say it here, **I made Calderón win** , although it’s not very
democratic to say that.”

In this regard, the head of the Executive Branch recalled the _desafuero_
proceedings against then-head of government Andrés Manuel López Obrador, as
well as the dirty campaign against him once he was already a presidential
candidate.

She recounted that in that electoral process the electoral authorities were
asked to recount the votes under the slogan that became famous, “vote by vote,
polling station by polling station,” which was carried out in **only 8 percent
of all polling stations** because that is what the Electoral Tribunal of the
Federal Judiciary decided.

> Today Fox affirms two terrible things: one, that he took part in the 2006
> election, and two, that governing Mexico is like governing a company and
> that it is a business.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum
